text: The overall effects of enhanced hedge fund regulation are not as immense as industry representatives predicted, but there is evidence that the enhanced Dodd-Frank Act rules do increase compliance costs for the industry.
citation: Kaal and Oesterle, The History of Hedge Fund Regulation in the United States (2016). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2714974

isBasedOn.name: The History of Hedge Fund Regulation in the United States

abstract: While the overall effects of enhanced hedge fund regulation are not as immense as hedge fund industry representatives had predicted, some evidence exists that enhanced rules under the Dodd-Frank Act increase the cost of compliance for the industry.
